tool_activity.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd && printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---' && rg --files -g '"'!__pycache__'"' -g '"'!*.pyc'"' . && printf '%s\\n' '--- TASK.md ---' && sed -n '1,240p' TASK.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- materials ---' && for f in materials/*; do printf '%s\\n' \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done && printf '"'%s\\n' '--- candidate.py ---' && sed -n '1,260p' candidate.py"
/bin/bash -c "git status --short 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s\\n' '--- candidate metadata ---'; stat -c '%n %s bytes' candidate.py TASK.md"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- material files ---' && rg --files materials | sort | xargs -r wc -l && printf '%s\\n' '--- libdevice rsqrt context ---' && rg -n -C 8 \"rsqrt\" materials/extra/cuda/libdevice.py"
/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,220p' candidate.py && printf '%s\\n' '--- structural checks ---' && rg -n \""'^import |''^@|triton'"\\.Config|autotune|rsqrt_kernel|def build|def wrapper\" candidate.py"

reason: Added Triton autotuning across 16 valid tile/warp configurations while preserving native tl.rsqrt semantics, masked bounds handling, and out-tensor behavior.
